Class Ir

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.frontend.Ir
public final class Ir extends Object
The explicit IR: one tree for the rich and the core explicit language of Clafer, as the Clafer compiler prints them (clafer -m clafer, with --core for the core). The core is a strict subset of the rich language, so a core model is a rich model without rich nodes. Whether a node is rich is a property of its type (Ir.Node.isRich()), never of a field value: every rich part of a declaration is a node of its own, e.g., a Ir.Modifier or an Ir.Initializer of a Ir.ClaferDecl, which is core. Core.richNodes(Ir.Model) lists the rich nodes of a tree.

The tree is the text: names are not resolved, and every declaration and constraint stays where it was written, so that ExplicitPrinter prints it back as it was read. Resolving the names is the job of what reads the tree, e.g., chocosolver's ToAst.

The records are immutable; their lists are unmodifiable copies.
